answer: A Design mockup merged by two maintainers backed by a refundable deposit makes identity cost real work: the design mockup is reviewed line by line, the refundable deposit is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so a Sybil farm must produce genuine, reviewed output for every fake account it wants. A lotus that appears twice is the tell: the same work cannot earn two identities. Between a crystal and a wharf lies the whole point: Sybils are cheap to mint but expensive to employ.
